'''Jennshain''' was a city in [[Almoren]], which was part of the [[Ten Nations]] in the centuries after the [[Breaking]]. Other than the name, and the fact that it is Ogier-built,{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 10}} little else is known about it. 

Its name translated into the Common Tongue is possibly "True Peace" - from the [[Old Tongue]] words ''jenn'' (meaning "true, truly, or even 'only true'") and ''shain'' (meaning "peace"). {{ref|{{twotc}}, Old Tongue Dictionary}}
